content.tagline: Weight loss as a daily habit, not starvation
content.descriptor: Korean health functional food for weight control: water-based sticks, capsules, a meal-replacement shake and enzyme formats. Seven items from a brand that has been running since 2011 and, according to the company, holds first place in the diet category on the Chinese market
about: SPRX makes products to be taken internally, not cosmetics. The company calls the category premium semi-medical inner beauty: something a person drinks or swallows as a capsule to manage their weight, rather than something applied to the skin. For an importer that difference is fundamental, so we put it right at the top of the profile.

The company tells the brand's story like this. In 2011 its founder worked as a marketer at an Australian women's fashion brand and saw a customer faint in the store after a harsh diet. He left the company, took up the study of nutrition, and then built a brand around the idea that weight comes off through routine and balance rather than hunger.

Today the company has its own R&D centre and manufacturing at sites certified to GMP and HACCP. Products are registered with Korea's Ministry of Food and Drug Safety (MFDS) as health functional food. All of this is stated by the company and is verifiable from documents at the deal stage.

The geography is split unevenly. China has been closed by an exclusive distributor since 2018, Japan since 2023. In Korea the company reports an expansion into MUSINSA Beauty and Mega Factory, a presence in approximately 300 pharmacies in the category and in every location of “Dalla”, a retail chain of sugar-free diet snacks. The remaining markets are free, and those are exactly the ones that interest the buyers who come to us.

lines.name: Health functional food
lines.note: Three items registered by the Korean regulator as health functional food. Watermix Zero is a water-based stick in two flavours, Watermix Zero Grapefruit and Watermix Zero Shine Muscat, 9 g per stick, 21 sticks to a box; the company states zero sugar content and an effect on post-meal blood sugar, body fat and bowel movement. Three Out is a 500 mg capsule, 90 to a pack, with patented garcinia, patented probiotics and pantothenic acid.

lines.name: Meal replacement and calorie control
lines.note: Poman Fullness Shake Green Coffee Bean is built on green coffee extract, alginate and glucomannan: 30 g per serving, 113 kcal, and the company states fullness for up to 240 minutes and swelling of the formula by 2,110%. Alpha CD Calozero is a 3 g stick with alpha-cyclodextrin of American origin; according to the company one serving binds up to 20.7 g of fat, which works out at roughly 186 kcal.

lines.name: Everyday wellbeing
lines.note: Westick Enzyme is an enzyme stick with mastic and a fermented grain complex. First Olive and Tomato Shot is an organic stick on Spanish tomatoes and extra virgin olive oil, 60% and 36.92% respectively.

tech.name: Patented raw materials
tech.note: In Watermix Zero and Three Out the company uses garcinia cambogia and resistant maltodextrin, and in the capsules probiotics as well, and it designates these components as patented. Patent numbers are not given in the materials and are requested at the deal stage.

tech.name: Alpha-cyclodextrin
tech.note: The base of Alpha CD Calozero, according to the company entirely of American origin. One 3 g serving binds up to 20.7 g of fat, which the company converts to roughly 186 kcal. The format is meant to be sprinkled over a dish before eating.

tech.name: The mechanics of fullness
tech.note: Poman Fullness Shake Green Coffee Bean is built on a combination of alginate and glucomannan, which swell in the stomach. The company gives two numbers: swelling of 2,110% and a feeling of fullness for up to 240 minutes.

tech.name: Enzyme activity
tech.note: The Westick Enzyme pack lists activity units for alpha-amylase and protease, but they are not fully legible in the photograph, so we do not quote them. We will ask the company for the exact values and add them once confirmed. The company positions the product as support for breaking down carbohydrates, which make up a large share of the modern diet.

tech.name: Manufacturing standards
tech.note: The company states manufacturing at sites certified to GMP and compliance with HACCP, as well as conformity with the requirements of Korea's Ministry of Food and Drug Safety (MFDS). Copies of the documents are provided at the deal stage through Teranova.

content.exportNote: Two of the company's markets are taken: China has been closed by an exclusive distributor since 2018, Japan since 2023. On every other direction the company is open to talks. The category matters here: this is not cosmetics but health functional food, so importing it almost anywhere calls for separate registration. In Brazil that is handled by ANVISA, in Mexico by COFEPRIS, in Chile by ISP. Timelines and document sets there are noticeably stricter than for skincare, and that is worth building into the plan from the very start.

terms.label: Documents
terms.value: The company states manufacturing to GMP and HACCP and registration of its products as health functional food with Korea's Ministry of Food and Drug Safety (MFDS). Full dossiers per item are requested at the deal stage.

terms.label: Import registration
terms.value: The products are health functional food rather than cosmetics, so most countries require separate registration. Timelines depend on the market and are planned for in advance.
